articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

articles.title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
articles.snippet: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.

articles.title: The legal drama of imprisoned Sam Bankman-Fried is waiting on its last act
articles.snippet: The fallen leader of the former top exchange FTX is looking for answers from the U.S. Supreme Court.

articles.title: Kalshi wants 24/7 Tesla and Nvidia perps as Wall Street fights over who regulates them
articles.snippet: The prediction-market operator plans to seek U.S. approval for about 60 stock and ETF perps, taking one of crypto's biggest trading products into equities.

articles.title: Why a new SEC plan could ease a legal headache for tokenized securities
articles.snippet: The SEC's new proposal to overhaul transfer-agent rules could eliminate duplicate offchain shareholder records, reducing reconciliation costs and legal uncertainty for tokenized securities.
